title: mssql-mcp-core: SQL injection in mssql-mcp write tools via unparameterized table names and WHERE clauses…
description: The mssql-mcp-core package contained SQL injection vulnerabilities due to unparameterized interpolation of table names, column names, and WHERE clauses in several tools. This allowed attackers supplying crafted inputs to execute arbitrary SQL statements, bypassing safety checks and potentially executing OS commands if the SQL login was privileged and xp_cmdshell enabled. The issue was fixed in version 0.6.0 by validating identifiers against allowlists and replacing free-form WHERE clauses with structured, parameterized filters.
